top_signals.title: ETFs Are an Engine of Growth, Says T. Rowe Price’s Sawyer
top_signals.summary: Dee Sawyer, head of global distribution at T. Rowe Price says ETFs are an engine of growth for the firm. She also talks about the acquisition of upstart ETF provider F/m Investments. She said the deal improves their investment capability. She speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Lockheed Martin, General Dynamics get framework deals to surge Patriot, THAAD production
top_signals.summary: The Pentagon's framework agreements with General Dynamics and Lockheed include tripling Patriot production and quadrupling THAAD interceptor output.
